bead.title: harness discovery leaks gemini CLI processes: probe spawns gemini and never reaps it (orphaned process-group leak)
bead.description:
PROBLEM: Harness discovery / quota probing spawns the gemini CLI on essentially every ddx work / ddx run startup (discovery probes all installed agent CLIs), and the spawned gemini process is NOT reaped — it reparents to init (ppid=1) and lingers for many hours. Observed on the dogfooding box: 123 leaked gemini agents aged 16-26h consuming ~31GB of swap, even though gemini is NOT used for real work and GEMINI_API_KEY is unset. Killing them dropped swap 35G->4.2G.
ROOT CAUSE: gemini is in PreferenceOrder (internal/harnesses/registry.go:6) and registered (registry.go:82-87, DefaultModel gemini-2.5-flash). The gemini harness discovery/quota path (internal/harnesses/gemini/model_discovery.go, quota_pty.go, runner.go) spawns gemini via PTY for model/quota discovery and does not terminate/reap the spawned process group on completion/timeout. progress_mirror.go:65 references a 'stale-harness reaper' for orphaned process groups, but it is not catching these discovery/quota probes. ddx's own integration test documents the leak: cli/internal/integration/lock_contention_test.go:226-229 (in the ddx repo) notes 'ddx work harness discovery probes whatever agent CLIs are installed (codex/claude/gemini), and at least one (gemini) [lingers] ... racing t.TempDir cleanup'.
PROPOSED FIX: (a) do NOT probe/discover a harness that is unconfigured/uncredentialed (skip gemini when GEMINI_API_KEY is unset / not enabled) so it is never spawned; and (b) ensure the discovery/quota PTY probe sets a process group (Setpgid) and kills it on completion AND timeout, wired into the stale-harness reaper. Apply the same guarantee to other PTY-probed harnesses.
NON-SCOPE: removing the gemini harness; ddx-side test cleanup.
bead.acceptance:
1. With GEMINI_API_KEY unset (and gemini not explicitly enabled), a harness-discovery/quota-probe pass spawns NO gemini process: a test runs discovery and asserts no orphaned/lingering gemini afterward.
2. When a harness IS probed via PTY, the probe runs in its own process group that is killed on completion and on timeout; a test asserts the probe child is reaped (no orphan).
3. go test ./internal/harnesses/... green
4. CI / pre-commit passes.
